policy_note: Repository evidence shows food.health.supplements.* names are being used as held/new-taxonomy candidates in prior sweep artifacts, not as confirmed pass41 catalog leaves. This proposal therefore does not promote vitamin, mineral, probiotic, omega-3, lutein, red-ginseng or collagen products to invented existing leaves. Where an earlier held candidate family is already established, that candidate is reused; otherwise the record is held for taxonomy-policy resolution without inventing a stable leaf id.
